name: Kashmir
intro: A valley with its own language, its own script in the past, and one of the grandest banquets anywhere.

carries.title: Wazwan
carries.text: The grand formal banquet, prepared by hereditary cooks known as waza. Guests traditionally sit in groups of four and share from a large copper plate called the traem.

carries.title: The Sharada script
carries.text: A fragment of the Rigveda written in the Sharada script is kept at the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute in Pune.
